notes.title: Patch 1.2.1.0: Now Live!
notes.notes: [p][b]WARNING: Save files made in this version cannot be loaded into older versions of the game![/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixes a bug where in the first Ongess battle if Cosette was in your party and you're on the bad ending route, the story dialogue could get caught in a loop until you manually restart the battle.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixes a potential crash in Battle of Far Port upon victory. [/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.2.0.9: Now Live!
notes.notes: [p][b]WARNING: Save files made in this version cannot be loaded into older versions of the game! [/b][/p][list][*][p]Contains a hot fix for a bad ending requirement. [spoiler]The Bad end previously would not trigger if you decide to go to Ryuvia, sink every ship except for Arcadius, then capture Arcadius' ship last.[/spoiler] [/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.2.0.8: Now Live!
notes.notes: [p][b]WARNING: Save files made in this version cannot be loaded into older versions of the game![/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where Qisah would run off screen in RPG battles after using the special Smash.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a crash that could occur due to a story forced retreat in RPG battles where Icari was in the middle of using Remeiken.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a theoretical crash that could occur if a unit is killed in a RPG battle at the same time a buff is being applied.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed various typos.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.2.0.7: Now Live!
notes.notes: [p][b]WARNING: Save files made in this version cannot be loaded into older versions of the game![/b][/p][list][*][p]For users with old GPUs struggling with low FPS, try holding down the letters W, A, T, E, R and the CTRL key at the same time in the battles to turn off the water. [b]This is not recommended if you are above the minimum system requirements found on the store page[/b].[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]The bounty gain of Divine Prayer is now 2.5x rather than 5x.[/p][/*][*][p]The self-fleet wide damage of Divine Prayer has been increased.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where voiced lines play the wrong voices if you save and load on the first line of the scene.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug which would cause the UI from choices to overlay on top of the Party Status Menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that resulted in Kryska's Counter passive not working in RPG battles.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that resulted in Kryska's Guard special not working in RPG battles.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that would cause enemies to follow Kryska off screen while she retreats under the effects of Taunt in RPG battles.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that would result in the Fire Proof Sails effect from your own ships getting applied to the enemy rather than youself.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that would lead to Lynn's sprite looping the animation for throwing a shuriken in RPG battles.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a crash that would occur if you try and proceed past the final scene screen without selecting a girl.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed various typos.[/p][/*][/list]
